diagnosis: The view queries TenantInvitation based on tenant_id passed as a query parameter without verifying that request.user is associated with that tenant schema. Any authenticated user can enumerate prospective employee email addresses, pending invitation tokens, and designated roles across competing tenant organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/tenants/invitations/?tenant_id=892 HTTP/1.1
Host: console.multitenant-saas.net
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_tenant_user>
